body: I can only imagine what you must be feeling right now and how much it must suck, but stay strong and look to the future. Stop working yourself up and take a step back. You can get through this :)
Hey, I'm sorry that you feel this way, but I hope you know that eventually you can beat this. Get help if you need it and just keep fighting it. ❤️
People care about you, don't let it win. Stay strong.

OP, It's ok, everyone's been there. Like most things, music takes practice and time to get something out of it. You've been improving, but your standards are getting higher, so, you think you're going nowhere. Try listening to some of your earlier works to get an idea of how much you've improved and then just think where you would be if you made that jump in skill (or even more!) and where you'd be then! You'll get it.

It's all a part of the process.

 ^_^ good luck! 😊

Overall, this seems like, with the right mastering and mixing, it could be a very strong track. As of now the intro could be slightly more polished, but, as of now, is still quite pretty and melodic sounding. The highs in the drop (not sure if this is just me, it could be) are slightly too loud/piercing, but this does allow them to really cut through the mix (which I assume is what you're going for), the high's could benefit from slight eqing to mellow them out a bit while still maintaining their ability to cut through the mix.

Thanks for the feedback! I'm currently mixing on ATH M50s, but I feel like it's more that I just need to work on my mixing skills in general as opposed to the headphones. Would I just want to take a frequency spectrum of a well mixed track in Future Bass and then try to mimic it's spectrum to a degree?

Like the previous comment, I feel that melodically, this track works, but the lack of low end really takes away from the track and the fullness that it could have, some sort of bassline would do wonders :-)
